provenance.confirmationBasis: On the owner's instruction on 1 November 2026, after this build downloaded the Commission's North West certified list (as supplemented, 23 October 2026) directly from elections.org.za, hashed it, and checked its structure; the owner states the list is the Commission's own, declared by it, and corroborated by the Commission's website and its video and by news reports. Independently, news reports (SAnews, EWN) confirm the 15 October 2026 Constitutional Court order for the ANC and the Commission's extension of the same relief to similarly affected parties across 107 municipalities, which is the supplementation the document is headed with. The case number CCT 282/26 itself was not found in those reports. A named individual has not been recorded; replace this with a person's name when there is one.
